note: Derived reading aid. Never authoritative; never read as intent (Decision 0004). The Plan document governs.
author: Lightweight model draft for Clara (technical writing) via Claudia Atlas <claudia.atlas@agents.arcadia.local>
title: Keep production running without host touches
purpose: Production should launch without the operator touching the host, stop spending tokens into a sandbox that cannot work, name every stall with a one-click fix, and avoid being stranded by a plan change. The plan's goal is four fixes from the first supervised run, each merged to main in its own pull request.
serves: The Project outcome of the operator being asked only when a decision is needed, with production stalls named rather than silent.
done_when: Four fixes from the first supervised run are merged to main, one per pull request, each with a regression test, and a stalled production run names its gate with a one-click fix.
reading_note: Draft: 3 of the 5 Actions are done. The stall escalation and the sandbox check before launch are still open.

actions.title: Stop a session that cannot write from spending tokens again
actions.why: A first session used about 11 million input tokens and produced no code, and nothing stopped a retry into the same wall.
actions.done_when: An attempt that ends with no diff and a named environment blocker is counted on the first occurrence, raises one named blocker, and is not relaunched automatically.

actions.title: Name each production stall with a one-click fix
actions.why: The first stall showed only a generic alert, with the real cause buried in a worker log.
actions.done_when: A replayed stall produces one named escalation with a one-click resolution and exactly one Discord ping, using the existing escalation mechanism.

actions.title: Declare each action's route and fix the approval check
actions.why: Keyword matches in the text sent a bug Plan's Actions to extra decisions, and a correct artifact was refused, costing four operator touches.
actions.done_when: An action's declared route decides its path regardless of wording, the preview shows the expected operator touches, and the artifact check judges each sentence on its own.

actions.title: Refuse plan changes that would strand an active run
actions.why: Another session once switched a Plan under an active run, stranding it, and the problem was found only in a log.
actions.done_when: Changing the current Plan of a Project under an active production scope is refused before anything is written, and the refusal names the STOP remedy.

actions.title: Refuse a session before launch if its sandbox cannot write
actions.why: A session that cannot write or validate would spend tokens for nothing, so it should be refused first.
actions.done_when: A session whose sandbox cannot write the workspace, run validation or produce a receipt is refused before launch, with a named remedy and no tokens spent.
